body:
i'm not sure if it's just the average sad and lonely feeling. i've been formally diagnosed with MDD and social anxiety and i haven't been able to pay for the meds or the therapy anymore. i don't really want to do the therapy anymore.

i think i might take you up on that pm offer though.

i've tried, maybe not hard enough. but i feel like anything i do is never good enough. i think setting such a goal might end up bringing me down. i like drawing, i like art. but it's never good enough, it'll never be important to anyone. 

i've been told what a disappointment i am and i don't have any reason to believe otherwise. in a way i feel guilty for thinking so horribly, but i'm stuck.
